package relationorder

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

const (
	parentID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000088"
	childID  = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089"
)

func TestNormalizeAcceptsOneDeterministicOrderedSet(t *testing.T) {
	parent, items, err := Normalize(" "+parentID+" ", []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{{ChildID: " " + childID + " ", Order: 7}})

	if err != nil || parent != parentID || len(items) != 1 || items[0].ChildID != childID || items[0].Order != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected normalization: parent=%q items=%#v err=%v", parent, items, err)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeRejectsEmptyDuplicateAndInvalidRelations(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		parent string
		items  []domain.CatalogRelationOrder
	}{
		{name: "invalid parent", parent: "bad", items: []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{{ChildID: childID, Order: 1}}},
		{name: "empty", parent: parentID},
		{name: "invalid child", parent: parentID, items: []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{{ChildID: "bad", Order: 1}}},
		{name: "duplicate child", parent: parentID, items: []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{{ChildID: childID, Order: 1}, {ChildID: childID, Order: 2}}},
		{name: "duplicate order", parent: parentID, items: []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{{ChildID: childID, Order: 1}, {ChildID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000090", Order: 1}}},
		{name: "negative order", parent: parentID, items: []domain.CatalogRelationOrder{{ChildID: childID, Order: -1}}},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, _, err := Normalize(test.parent, test.items); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}
